notes: Built for MT5 forex, which publishes volume 0 at top of book. Uses only
bid/ask, spread and time. Deliberately uses NO queue imbalance, NO OFI, NO
volume and NO synthesised depth — those are undefined on this feed and the
depth-based baseline_scalper correctly declines every quote because of it.
Thresholds are STRUCTURAL DEFAULTS, not fitted values. No optimisation has
been run against any dataset. Gate A requires 3 months of real recorded
data; at time of writing the capture is hours old.
entry_momentum is a mean log return per quote. FX ticks are ~1e-5 relative
moves, so the scale is necessarily small; it is not a percentage.
Architecture Part 4: params are emitted by research and validated by C++
against both hashes, which refuses to start on mismatch. The hashes below
are placeholders until a Phase 8 run produces a signed set.
